title: DrawWaveResponse
description: The wave's merge card and whether merge is offered, with the reason on the card when it is not.

card.description: The wave's merge card: the answer, each slice's block, then the wave's own lines.

lines.description: One line for each thing the card says, wrapped by the kernel to 44 columns.

mark.description: Every line of this card comes from a step that ran no skill.

words.description: What the owner reads, worked out by script.

step.description: The step of the wave that the line cites.

merge.description: Why merge is withheld, as one sentence or more.

withheld.description: The reason for merge when it is withheld; empty when merge is offered.

merge.description: Offered only when at least one slice passed its own proof, every such slice merged cleanly into the combined head, and the wave's checks passed there.
